Intro#Where to begin? I’m honestly glad I can get the chance to start writing here. It will be interesting to see where this website ends up in the future. It will also be fun to track my progress as a developer, seeing all the projects that I have done added to this neat collection.
If you haven’t already, please go take a look at my About Me page.
What can readers expect to see here?#Anything really! Depends on what I want to write or ramble about. It will most likely fall into these three categories:
Cool programming stuff or any new game development venture Garage project write-ups and videos Life achievements or updates I’ve really had a kick lately for wanting to record and document anything that I work on my garage, and will potentially be doing that in the next couple of months.
Documentation#For now, that section is a WIP. I need to consolidate libraries that I’ve released or want to release into this website, but first of all I need to get the rest of my portfolio projects into the website as well. What’s a portfolio website without any portfolio to view, right?
Anyway, thats all I got for this one. See ya!

content:
Role: Systems & UI Programmer#Choo Choo Boom Boom was made within the Game Studio @ Champlain College. This was the culmination of our efforts throughout the previous years at Champlain, and was made as our capstone project. I worked on some of the core gun systems including the sought after BFRG, as well as most of the core interface programming.
What is Choo Choo Boom Boom?#Choo Choo Boom Boom stems from the idea of a literal on-rails shooter. What if you were a train, with a gun, that fights an otherworldly entity?
Our team had conceptualized other ideas early on the development process for this game, such as one of the prototypes that I ended up working on, a game where you were a diver who would dive from ridiciously high heights. Choo Choo Boom Boom stood out as a project that had potential, and the team at In Scope Studio certainly wanted to prove it’s worth. Through rigorous development, the game made it throught the arduous greenlighting process, which kicked off the Spring production.
How can I play Choo Choo Boom Boom?#Steam Store Page
The game will be releasing on Steam on May 1st, and is participating in the annual Game Studio Senior Show!
